test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

I quietly went out __at__ the door into the veranda.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of an** incorrect preposition.**
 
• The phrase "at the door" is not appropriate in this context.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"through the door,"** which indicates the action of passing from one side of the door to the other.
 
• Thus, "through" is the most appropriate substitution for the underlined segment.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I quietly went out** through the door** into the veranda."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **No substitution required** would be the correct option if the original sentence was already correct, but "at the door" is incorrect in this context.
 
• **From** could indicate direction but does not fit well here.
 
• **By** indicates proximity but not the action of moving through a door.
